goal: 让 make-decision detail 只依赖公开三项材料，并在 provider 前绑定当前 decision-log 与 material revision。
non_goals: 不新增 provider fallback 或重试状态机
stop_conditions: 需要第二份 decision-log、caller runner 指令、provider fallback 或新 detail 公共命令
expected_handoff: detail provider 只看到完整当前决定和待审材料；缺字段、禁止字段、类型、身份或 freshness 错误在 provider 前留下 unavailable 事实；早期阶段不自动复用旧结果。

red.result: 6 of 9 assertions failed: caller-supplied review_instructions was silently overwritten, stale approved_direction reached the provider, non-text input was not diagnosed as type, freshness binding was absent, and the public validator was missing.

green.result: 9 tests passed; valid detail sent the complete decision-log once, six preflight classes skipped provider dispatch, and repeated detail execution produced a new result without reuse.

coverage_limits: 不证明第三方 provider 语义质量
不覆盖产品 UI、浏览器或下游验收
当前 fixture 不替代真实 provider 可用性
